paragraphs: It's a good day to find the answer you need without being swayed by confusing accounts. You may recognise unsuitable conditions even when dealing with someone you've known a long time, or bring something unnecessary to a clean end. Some disappointment may remain, but you could make fewer decisions you'll regret later.
If you need to refuse, give a brief reason. Stating the facts doesn't require judging the other person or adding criticism.
overall.swords.13.upright.do: Give a brief reason for saying no
overall.swords.13.upright.pause: Pointing out someone's faults while refusing them

overall.swords.13.reversed.headline: A hasty judgement could lead to an unfair misunderstanding.
paragraphs: One bad impression could lead you to judge wrongly today. You may reach a conclusion before hearing the other person's circumstances, or someone who knows nothing about your situation could misunderstand you. A sharp reply may leave you with even less chance to explain the facts.
When you first hear a story, check whether anything is missing. Disliking someone doesn't mean what they're saying this time must be wrong.
overall.swords.13.reversed.do: Check what's missing from one person's account
overall.swords.13.reversed.pause: Ignoring everything someone says because you dislike them

overall.swords.14.upright.headline: Clear rules could settle something that was uncertain.
paragraphs: Even a much-debated issue may reach a conclusion based on clear standards today. Evidence could settle an argument over who's right, and you may receive a judgement you can trust. If you've prepared your facts properly, you'll be well placed to explain your position.
For an important decision, present information that can be checked instead of relying on a feeling. Trying to change the rules to suit yourself could make a sound judgement harder to reach.
overall.swords.14.upright.do: Check the evidence supporting your position
overall.swords.14.upright.pause: Changing the rules only when it benefits you

overall.swords.14.reversed.headline: One-sided demands could put you in a difficult position.
paragraphs: You may meet someone unwilling to listen even when you explain your circumstances today. You could be pushed to accept unsuitable terms or feel unfairly treated by a decision based on only one account. Agreeing immediately because the other person intimidates you may be hard to undo.
For something important, ask for time to check before answering. When you're the one making a decision, let others finish their explanations too.
overall.swords.14.reversed.do: Ask for time to check before answering
overall.swords.14.reversed.pause: Agreeing as soon as someone applies pressure

overall.pentacles.01.upright.headline: It's a good day to get what you need and start something new.
paragraphs: An opportunity that offers practical help may come your way today. You could find an item you need or have the place and preparations ready for something you've wanted to start. Having the means to try an idea in practice could feel satisfying.
Once the opportunity is there, put whatever you can to use. Leaving it untouched while waiting for something better could mean missing the moment you need it.
overall.pentacles.01.upright.do: Put a new opportunity to use
overall.pentacles.01.upright.pause: Waiting for something better when you already have what you can use

overall.pentacles.01.reversed.headline: Something good could have little immediate use for you.
paragraphs: An apparently good offer may not be much help in practice today. You could receive more than you need without getting what you actually want, or a new opportunity may be difficult to use right now. Getting plenty doesn't necessarily mean you'll feel satisfied.
First consider whether it's something you need now. Instead of collecting more similar things because you've heard they're good, check how you can use what you already have.
overall.pentacles.01.reversed.do: Check whether you need what you've received now
overall.pentacles.01.reversed.pause: Collecting more similar things because they look good

overall.pentacles.02.upright.headline: You could manage several things well even on a busy day.
paragraphs: You may handle overlapping tasks successfully today. Even if something unexpected comes up, changing the timing could solve it, and keeping two things going may bring good results. Things don't have to happen exactly as planned to stay manageable.
If your priorities change, look again at the time you have left. Being honest about when you're available will make it easier for other people to adjust too.
overall.pentacles.02.upright.do: Rearrange your time to fit changed plans
overall.pentacles.02.upright.pause: Agreeing to two things at the same time

overall.pentacles.02.reversed.headline: Trying to do several things at once could make you miss a commitment.
paragraphs: Things you thought you could manage may overlap and cause trouble today. A mistake in timing could make you late, or dealing with something urgent may make you forget another task. Pretending everything is fine and carrying on with it all could leave more to sort out later.
If two arrangements clash, ask in advance to change one of them. Don't squeeze another commitment into a day that's already tight.
overall.pentacles.02.reversed.pause: Adding another commitment to a full schedule

overall.pentacles.03.upright.headline: Your work could earn recognition and improve with help from others.
paragraphs: Something you've put care into may receive a good response today. Someone could recognise what you do well, while another person's help may make up for what's missing. Combining what each of you has done could bring a more satisfying finish than working alone.
If you're doing something together, start by saying what you do well. It's fine to hear the other person's explanation and leave the parts they know better to them.
overall.pentacles.03.upright.do: Share the work according to what each person does well
overall.pentacles.03.upright.pause: Trying to decide every method alone

overall.pentacles.03.reversed.headline: A lack of experience could mean doing something again.
paragraphs: You may spot shortcomings in something you thought was finished today. People could understand their parts differently, or you might miss something while trying to finish an unfamiliar task alone. Treating a small correction as an argument could delay the finish further.
Ask someone experienced to check the parts you don't know well. Pride doesn't have to stop you accepting a useful explanation.
overall.pentacles.03.reversed.do: Ask someone experienced about an unfamiliar part
overall.pentacles.03.reversed.pause: Making excuses as soon as a mistake is pointed out

overall.pentacles.04.upright.headline: It's a good day to keep what you've achieved without major changes.
paragraphs: Something familiar could continue steadily today. What you already have may be enough to deal with what's needed, without a hurried change. You're more likely to find satisfaction in what's going well now than in an uncertain offer.
Look at what you already have before deciding whether you need something new. A brief request for help doesn't have to make you fear you'll lose everything.
overall.pentacles.04.upright.do: Solve a problem with what you already have
overall.pentacles.04.upright.pause: Automatically refusing even a small request for help

overall.pentacles.04.reversed.headline: Opposition could delay things longer than expected.
paragraphs: You may find it hard to go ahead with what you want today. The agreement you need could be withheld, or a longer queue may mean waiting again. Insisting on your own way may not persuade the other person to change their answer.
Find out why the answer is no first. If the conditions can change a little, ask when it might be possible again.
overall.pentacles.04.reversed.do: Ask why you were refused and when it may be possible
overall.pentacles.04.reversed.pause: Repeating the same demand to hurry someone along

overall.pentacles.05.upright.headline: A shortage of help or resources could make the day difficult.
paragraphs: Things may feel harder to manage than usual today. Something you need could be difficult to find, or a person you expected to help may be unable to join you. Seeing others appear to do well while your own affairs are stuck could also feel upsetting.
Say specifically what you need right now. Feeling bad about accepting help doesn't mean you have to struggle alone with something essential.
overall.pentacles.05.upright.do: Ask specifically for the help you need now
overall.pentacles.05.upright.pause: Refusing necessary help because you feel bad accepting it

overall.pentacles.05.reversed.headline: Disagreements could leave you with more work to do.
paragraphs: Even small things may be difficult because people can't agree today. Something you intended to solve together could turn into an argument, or doing the same thing separately may waste time. Rushing to put things right could mean redoing something already finished.
When things become tangled, finish what's under way before starting more. Taking back work you've given someone else because you're angry could only add to your own load.
overall.pentacles.05.reversed.do: Finish the tasks that have gone wrong one at a time
overall.pentacles.05.reversed.pause: Taking over someone else's work out of anger

overall.pentacles.06.upright.headline: An unexpected gift or helping hand could make the day easier.
paragraphs: Someone may do you a favour just when you need it today. They could share something you've been looking for or help with a difficult task. If you have room to give, a small offer of help from you could be warmly received too.
Thank the person who helped you. Before helping someone else, ask what they actually need.
overall.pentacles.06.upright.pause: Insisting on helping without asking whether it's needed

overall.pentacles.06.reversed.headline: You may feel that what people receive isn't fairly shared.
paragraphs: Receiving less help than you expected could leave you disappointed today. You may feel that others are getting more, or something given as a favour could come with an unexpected demand. Dwelling on comparisons may make things uncomfortable with the person who helped too.
Speak up about any conditions you find hard to accept. Disappointment in your own share doesn't mean you need to belittle what someone else received.
overall.pentacles.06.reversed.do: Check the conditions attached to help first

overall.pentacles.07.upright.headline: Steady effort could show a small result.
paragraphs: The time and work you've put in may begin to show today. Even if you aren't finished, you could see an improvement and judge whether it's worth continuing. Something you've kept working on may give you more than a hurried new start.
Take a calm look at what's done and what remains. Skipping necessary steps to see a result sooner could waste the work you've already put in.
overall.pentacles.07.upright.do: Check what you've completed so far
overall.pentacles.07.upright.pause: Skipping necessary steps to finish quickly

overall.pentacles.07.reversed.headline: It may be hard to tell whether more effort will improve the result.
paragraphs: Putting in more time and effort may not bring an immediate reward today. After a long wait, you could be asked to wait again, or have to decide whether to keep helping. Taking on more just because you don't want earlier effort to go to waste could prolong the burden.
Before giving more time, ask when it will be finished. If there's no clear end, it's fine to offer only what you can manage right now.
overall.pentacles.07.reversed.do: Ask when the work ends before taking on more
overall.pentacles.07.reversed.pause: Accepting more just to justify the time already spent

overall.pentacles.08.upright.headline: Practice could give you a chance to show your skill.
paragraphs: You could finish a familiar task skilfully today. Something that used to take a long time may become easier, and a method you've practised could prove useful. The results may not look spectacular, but your effort is likely to bring a clear return.
Keep using the method that's working and finish what's left. Rushing through something because it's boring could leave you disappointed with a small detail.
overall.pentacles.08.upright.do: Finish the task with a familiar method
overall.pentacles.08.upright.pause: Doing a careless job because the task is repetitive

overall.pentacles.08.reversed.headline: Something you tried to finish easily could create more trouble.
paragraphs: A shortcut you relied on could reveal a problem today. Something finished only well enough to look convincing may need redoing, and skipping a check because you're skilled could expose an omission. Clearing up afterwards may take longer than the quick finish saved.
Complete the necessary checks even on something you do well. Actually correcting a shortcoming will protect trust better than explaining it away.
overall.pentacles.08.reversed.pause: Using fine words to cover up a shortcoming

overall.pentacles.09.upright.headline: You could enjoy the comfort you've worked to secure.
paragraphs: What you've done could help you have a satisfying day. You may finish what you need easily on your own and have enough available that you don't need to wait for help. It's a good day to make time for something enjoyable you've put off.
If you've finished something well, mark it in a way you enjoy. There's no need to attend something you don't want to just to impress other people.
overall.pentacles.09.upright.do: Celebrate an achievement by doing something you enjoy
overall.pentacles.09.upright.pause: Going somewhere you don't want to just to impress others

overall.pentacles.09.reversed.headline: Something that looks well prepared could prove lacking.
paragraphs: A difference between the terms you trusted and the reality could disappoint you today. A place that looked well equipped may lack something necessary, or something described as ready could fall short when it begins. An impressive-looking choice may be inconvenient in your own daily life.
Before using something or taking part, inspect whatever you can yourself. Don't confidently recommend it to others on appearances alone.
overall.pentacles.09.reversed.do: Inspect the conditions you can see for yourself
overall.pentacles.09.reversed.pause: Assuring others something is good based only on appearances

overall.pentacles.10.upright.headline: Long-standing connections and experience could give you solid support.
paragraphs: Things may go steadily when you're with familiar people today. Old records or experience could supply information you don't know, and people around you may help with a difficulty. What you've built up could prove useful without a fresh effort from scratch.
Look for information you organised before or draw on the experience of someone you've known a long time. With reliable help available, you don't need to start everything over.
overall.pentacles.10.upright.do: Look up information you organised before
overall.pentacles.10.upright.pause: Throwing away records that are still useful

overall.pentacles.10.reversed.headline: One overambitious choice could disrupt things that were going well.
paragraphs: A decision based on luck alone could bring unexpected setbacks today. Abruptly changing something familiar that works or making several commitments depend on one result may cause a series of problems. Choose carefully so you don't lose everything you've built up at once.
Try something new on a small scale while keeping what you're already doing. You don't need to change everything just because someone says it will go well.
overall.pentacles.10.reversed.do: Try a new method while keeping the current one
overall.pentacles.10.reversed.pause: Changing everything on the assumption of one success

overall.pentacles.11.upright.headline: Something you learn could prove useful in practice.
paragraphs: Looking into something carefully could give you a useful answer today. You may learn a method and use it straight away or hear news containing information you need. Even if the first step is small, the day favours steady progress.
Try a newly learned method on something simple. Don't dismiss an explanation as something you already know before you've heard it all.
overall.pentacles.11.upright.do: Try a method you've just learned
overall.pentacles.11.upright.pause: Skipping an explanation because it sounds familiar

overall.pentacles.11.reversed.headline: A distraction could make you miss an opportunity you need.
paragraphs: Tasks may slip behind and expected news could disappoint you today. Spending time on something fun may make you read an important notice late, or a new activity could quickly seem uninteresting. You may make a mistake that a little more checking would have prevented.
Read the notices that need attention now first. If there's something you've wanted to try, complete the necessary first steps before deciding it's boring.
overall.pentacles.11.reversed.do: Read a notice you've put off
overall.pentacles.11.reversed.pause: Postponing necessary tasks to chase only what's fun

overall.pentacles.12.upright.headline: You could finish what you set out to do, even at a slow pace.
paragraphs: It's a good day to handle familiar tasks reliably. You may not see a dramatic change, but you could deliver what you promised and earn trust through steady work. You should be able to finish what's needed today without rushing.
Finish things one by one in the order you've been following. Abruptly changing methods because someone else finished faster could create extra trouble.
overall.pentacles.12.upright.do: Finish one thing at a time in your usual order
overall.pentacles.12.upright.pause: Changing methods in a hurry because someone else is faster

overall.pentacles.12.reversed.headline: Postponed tasks could make even small things troublesome.
paragraphs: Something you've been doing may make little progress today. Neglecting a familiar task could lead to omissions, or restarting something you've put off may take time. Your usual method may no longer fit the current situation either.
Check how things stand with one task you haven't touched for a while. Repeatedly putting things aside to do all at once later could leave even more unfinished.
overall.pentacles.12.reversed.do: Check one task you've put off for a long time
overall.pentacles.12.reversed.pause: Putting something off again to do it all later

overall.pentacles.13.upright.headline: Having what you need could make the day comfortable.
paragraphs: Other people's consideration could help the day pass smoothly. You may find a necessary item or place without difficulty and finish delayed household chores more easily than expected. You could even have enough time or resources to look after someone else.
If you have more than enough of something, share it with someone who needs it. Help you can give easily is enough, without doing so much that you can't finish your own tasks.
overall.pentacles.13.upright.do: Share items you have to spare
overall.pentacles.13.upright.pause: Putting off your own tasks to look after others

overall.pentacles.13.reversed.headline: Unnecessary suspicion could create more work for you.
paragraphs: Even something that's fine may feel hard to trust today, making things more troublesome. Repeated questions about a confirmed fact or doubts about someone's offer of help could stall a conversation. Changing your choice without a clear reason may leave things less convenient than before.
Check specifically what's worrying you. Once you've had an answer, decide on the basis of what you've confirmed instead of repeating the same suspicion.
overall.pentacles.13.reversed.do: Check the condition you're worried about once
overall.pentacles.13.reversed.pause: Doubting someone offering help without any evidence

overall.pentacles.14.upright.headline: A choice based on experience could bring a satisfying result.
paragraphs: Something you know how to do in practice could bring good results today. Experience may help you solve a seemingly complicated problem and get what you need to finish without strain. An experienced person could offer specific help too.
Start with a method you've used before instead of making bold promises. A proven approach may suit the situation better than an eye-catching new one.
overall.pentacles.14.upright.do: Use a method that has worked before
overall.pentacles.14.upright.pause: Guaranteeing success with a method you've never tried

overall.pentacles.14.reversed.headline: Wanting more could cost you something you've already gained.
paragraphs: Chasing better terms could make things go wrong today. You may add demands after receiving a satisfactory answer or accept something beyond your means to keep up appearances. Choosing what looks successful over what actually benefits you could leave a burden behind.
Once the terms are good enough, decide where to stop. Don't tell people you can do something beyond your ability just to impress them.
overall.pentacles.14.reversed.do: Decide which terms to accept and when to stop
overall.pentacles.14.reversed.pause: Accepting something you can't do to save face
